_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with Micron's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all.' 'Volatility in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory and storage products may adversely affect our business.' 'The semiconductor memory and storage markets are highly competitive.' (FY2022 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; the 10-K names AI only among the markets and applications Micron sells into ('Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.'), its own demand and not a substitute for its products (the NVDA reading), and no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is scoped to a memory maker (EV, live from 2020-01-01, is scoped to combustion powertrains, auto parts and fuel retail, and CRYPTO, live from 2020-10-21, to payments, banks and exchanges), so the watch list is empty

classification.quality_note: 'We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all.' 'Volatility in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory and storage products may adversely affect our business.' 'The semiconductor memory and storage markets are highly competitive.' (FY2022 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; the 10-K names AI only among the markets and applications Micron sells into ('Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.'), its own demand and not a substitute for its products (the NVDA reading), and no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is scoped to a memory maker (EV, live from 2020-01-01, is scoped to combustion powertrains, auto parts and fuel retail, and CRYPTO, live from 2020-10-21, to payments, banks and exchanges), so the watch list is empty. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.71x; +51% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.98; conservative 2yr +8%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -57.0%/yr (worst year FY14-FY22 ex-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -57.9%/yr (Q3 FY23 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.6-yr ex-FY13 ex-FY16 median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.0%/yr (FY14-FY22 ex-FY16 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +80.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY22 ex-FY16, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MU (retrospective, 2023-04-06) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.71x (89.0% downside to Bear $6.43 / +125.6% upside to Bull $132.10) | Adj composite 1.27 vs market 2.25: gap -0.98 [OVERVALUED] | +51% above the EPP floor $38.75 (5x FY23E $7.75) | Conservative 2-yr case: +7.5% total (+3.7%/yr) | At 7.6x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $77.45 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue -52.6% YoY in Q2 FY23, forward revenues -59.5% to -54.9% (Q3 FY23 revenue guide (Q2 FY23 results (8-K ex.99.1, Business Outlook))); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
